description: Schéma directeur des infrastructures de recharge pour véhicules électriques et hybrides rechargeables de Territoire d'énergie Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Territoire d’énergie Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Territoire d’énergie Loire-Atlantique. Le SDIRVE sur le périmètre de TE44 a été validé en Comité syndical le 28 Mars 2024. Ce jeu de données répond au spécifications du schéma "Schéma directeur des infrastructures de recharge pour véhicules électriques et hybrides rechargeables" disponible sur le site schema.data.gouv.fr. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are Mobilité, IRVE, TE44. The portal shows 180 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-09-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-te44-fr-portal.
